title: Bose Headphones Cannot Pair via Bluetooth
shortDescription: QuietComfort or 700/Ultra cannot connect to phone over Bluetooth.
fullDescription:
Bose headphones store up to 8 paired devices. When the list is full, new pairing fails silently.

A stale entry on the phone or a previously connected device hijacking the headphones is also common.
symptoms: Bose Music app cannot find headphones

fixSteps.title: Clear list
fixSteps.instruction: Hold Bluetooth button (or power slider for 700/Ultra) for 10 sec to clear pairings.

fixSteps.title: Forget on phone
fixSteps.instruction: Bluetooth settings -> Forget the device, then re-pair.

fixSteps.title: Use Bose Music app
fixSteps.instruction: Bose Music app -> Add Product to guide pairing.

faq.a: Yes, two devices simultaneously on QC 45 and newer.

title: Active Noise Cancellation Reduced or Off
shortDescription: Noise cancellation suddenly weak or completely absent.
fullDescription:
Bose ANC relies on external mics to sample ambient noise. A clogged mic mesh, low battery, or an old firmware can drop ANC effectiveness.

On QC Ultra, the Aware Mode toggle may have switched while pocketed.

fixSteps.title: Set Quiet Mode
fixSteps.instruction: Bose Music app -> Modes -> Quiet (max ANC).

fixSteps.title: Clean mic mesh
fixSteps.instruction: Soft brush over the small mic dots on each earcup.

fixSteps.title: Update firmware
fixSteps.instruction: Bose Music app -> Settings -> Software update.

whenToCallPro: If one earcup ANC failed (unbalanced), likely mic hardware issue.

faq.a: Yes, worn earpads degrade passive isolation and affect feedback ANC.

title: Charge LED Off / No Charge
shortDescription: Headphones do not charge when plugged in.
fullDescription:
Bose headphones use USB-C (QC 45/Ultra) or micro-USB (older QC 35). A bad cable, dirty port, or deeply discharged battery can prevent charging.

If left fully discharged for months, lithium cells need a slow trickle to recover.

fixSteps.title: Clean port
fixSteps.instruction: Remove lint with wooden toothpick from USB-C port.

fixSteps.title: Try other cable
fixSteps.instruction: Use the supplied Bose cable plus a 5V/1A wall adapter.

fixSteps.title: Long charge
fixSteps.instruction: Leave plugged in 4 hours to recover deep discharge.

whenToCallPro: If 4-hour charge yields nothing — battery replacement needed (Bose service).

faq.a: Possible on QC 35 with iFixit guide; QC 45 is harder.

title: Callers Cannot Hear You Clearly
shortDescription: Outgoing voice is muffled or low on Bluetooth calls.
fullDescription:
Bose headphones use beamforming mics on the earcups. On Bluetooth calls Android forces SCO codec, which is low-bandwidth and may sound bad even on premium headphones.

The Self-Voice setting may also be set to None.

causes.cause: Mic mesh covered by hair / hood

symptoms: Callers complain of low / muffled voice

fixSteps.title: Self Voice on
fixSteps.instruction: Bose Music -> Settings -> Self Voice -> Medium.

fixSteps.title: Quiet environment
fixSteps.instruction: Move to less windy / noisy area for important calls.

videoSearchQuery: Bose 700 mic low on calls fix

faq.q: Calls still SCO with LE Audio?
faq.a: Newer LE Audio supports higher quality but device support is limited.

title: Audio Only on One Side
shortDescription: Audio plays in only the left or right earcup.
fullDescription:
If only one earcup plays, check phone balance setting (Accessibility -> Audio balance). Otherwise the internal driver wire may be broken at the headband pivot.

This is common on QC 35 II after years of folding/unfolding.

causes.cause: Phone balance slid to one side

fixSteps.title: Check balance
fixSteps.instruction: Phone Settings -> Accessibility -> Audio Balance -> center.

fixSteps.title: Test other source
fixSteps.instruction: Try a different phone or laptop to confirm headphones vs source.

fixSteps.title: Repair internal cable
fixSteps.instruction: Open earcup pad, replace driver wire (iFixit guide).

whenToCallPro: If unfamiliar with disassembly — Bose offers flat-rate repair.
videoSearchQuery: Bose QC 35 one side quiet repair

title: Bose 700 / Ultra Touch Surface Unresponsive
shortDescription: Right-cup touch surface no longer responds to taps or swipes.
fullDescription:
Touch controls on the QC 700 and Ultra are capacitive. Sweat, lotion, or moisture under the surface can cause false reads or no reads.

A software glitch can also disable the touch sensor; a reset usually restores it.

fixSteps.title: Wipe surface
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe right earcup with dry microfiber.

fixSteps.title: Reset
fixSteps.instruction: Power off, plug into USB charger for 5 sec, then power on.

whenToCallPro: If touch fails after reset — capacitive panel hardware fault.

title: Crackling Audio Over Bluetooth
shortDescription: Random pops and crackles during music playback.
fullDescription:
Bluetooth audio crackle is usually due to congestion in the 2.4 GHz band (Wi-Fi, microwaves), or distance from the source. Bose QC Ultra adds aptX Adaptive which is more robust, but not all phones support it.

Reduce distance or change codec selection in app.

fixSteps.title: Reduce distance
fixSteps.instruction: Keep phone in front pocket, line of sight to head.

fixSteps.title: Switch codec
fixSteps.instruction: Bose Music -> Audio -> select aptX Adaptive on supported phones.

title: QC Ultra Immersive Audio Cannot Activate
shortDescription: Immersive Audio toggle does not enable spatial mode.
fullDescription:
Immersive Audio on QC Ultra requires Bose Music app and minimum firmware 1.1. Some streaming services (e.g., older Spotify versions) do not provide head-tracking metadata.

Motion mode also requires the head sensor to be calibrated.

fixSteps.title: Update firmware
fixSteps.instruction: Bose Music app -> Settings -> Software update.

fixSteps.title: Calibrate
fixSteps.instruction: Bose Music -> Immersive Audio -> Calibrate (face forward, hold still).

videoSearchQuery: Bose QC Ultra Immersive Audio fix

title: Headphones Cannot SimpleSync to Bose Soundbar
shortDescription: QC headphones fail to connect to Bose soundbar via SimpleSync.
fullDescription:
SimpleSync lets compatible Bose headphones share audio with a Bose soundbar. Both products must support SimpleSync (Soundbar 500/700/900 plus QC 700/Ultra/45).

Keep both products near each other during initial pair.
symptoms: Cannot find headphones in Bose Music app for soundbar

fixSteps.title: Check compatibility
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm both items in SimpleSync compatibility list.

fixSteps.title: Pair via app
fixSteps.instruction: Bose Music -> Soundbar -> Connect Speaker -> select headphones.

faq.a: About 9 m / 30 ft line of sight.

title: Headphones Stuck During Firmware Update
shortDescription: Bose Music app reports firmware update did not complete.
fullDescription:
Firmware updates over Bluetooth can stall if the connection drops or the phone goes to sleep. Headphones usually retain old firmware on failure.

Bose Updater desktop tool over USB-C is a reliable recovery path.

fixSteps.title: Retry over USB
fixSteps.instruction: Visit btu.bose.com on a computer, plug headphones in via USB-C, run Updater.

fixSteps.title: Reset
fixSteps.instruction: Power slider off 30 sec, then back on. Re-pair.

whenToCallPro: If headphones fail to enumerate even via USB.

faq.a: Some bug fixes (battery, ANC) are important; do not skip indefinitely.
